# @evotechly/ui 0.3.0 (unpublished snapshot)

EvoCRM consumes this package via workspace. Do not publish.

- Import: `import { Button, Sidebar, DataTable, KanbanBoard } from '@evotechly/ui'`
- Styles: `import '@evotechly/ui/styles.css'`
- HTML: `<html lang="fr" data-product="crm" data-theme="light">`
- CRM tokens: paper #EAEAEA, ink #0D1B24, orange #D9500F (primary only), teal selection
- Shell: 212px dark sidebar, light workspace, single top strip
- Catalog: src/catalog.json
- Agent notes: AGENTS.md
